name: High Altitude Chocolate Chip Cookies
desc: Chewy chocolate chip cookies with an extra egg and extra flour to hold their shape at altitude.

source.title: Ultimate High-Altitude Chocolate Chip Cookies
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (3 eggs, 3 1/2 cups flour, 1 cup each white and brown sugar, 1 cup chips) and the same heaping-teaspoon drop and 350°F, 12 to 15 minute bake.

ingredients.raw: 3 1/2 cups all-purpose flour (4.25 oz per cup)

steps: Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt together in a bowl.
Beat the butter, granulated sugar and brown sugar with an electric mixer until smooth. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Add the flour mixture and beat only until incorporated. Stir in the chocolate chips.
Drop heaping teaspoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake 12-15 minutes, until the edges begin to turn golden. Cool a few minutes on the sheets, then move to wire racks.

references.title: Ultimate High-Altitude Chocolate Chip Cookies
references.usedFor: unsalted butter, mixing order, 2-inch spacing on ungreased sheets, cooling, yield
